source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: What kinds of inputs should you include in a small initial skill evaluation?

options.text: A varied set of easy examples with short, clearly written sources
options.feedback: Variety among easy cases can show some behavior, but difficult inputs are needed to expose weaknesses those cases miss.

options.text: Representative examples plus at least one difficult case
options.feedback: Typical inputs show ordinary behavior, while a difficult case can reveal weaknesses that easy examples hide.

options.text: Repeated runs of the example used to develop the first draft
options.feedback: Repeating one example can show behavior on that input, but provides narrow evidence about variation across intended tasks.

options.text: A collection of the examples that produced the best-looking outputs
options.feedback: Selecting favorable results can conceal weaknesses. Include representative inputs and a difficult case before judging performance.
